title: Advancements+
description: This adds as many mods I could find for advancements, with some other QOL mods.
body:
**Dont forget to turn on the resource packs in the menu!**
Have you ever finished all of the achivements and thought "Hmm, this is too easy. I want something that will give me a run for my money!"? Well, you found the right modpack! This adds advancements for every block in the game, a new UI for the advancements tab, and over 50 other advancements, with plaques for them!
There are also other mods that are not advancement related mods, such as:
- 3D Skin Layers,
- AmbientSounds,
- Sodium,
- Sodium extra,
- and many more... (subject to change)
